args.query: Pellow Home Living Covey Lark rename

args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion on the coastal accounts:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 February.
- PHL is also used for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (the Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on "PHL" returns two different businesses.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living so it matches the account name.

Could you check whether any other saved views or reports still use the Covey & Lark name? I can make the relabel on the coastal side once you confirm which report it is.

Thanks,
Sofia
